title: Evaluation-compatible Koszul and Roos comparison over completed coefficients
statement: Let T be a scheme, A a commutative ring and d the Noetherian completed coefficient datum of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], with ideal I. Let K be any object of D(Mod(A_T)), M a K-flat complex representing K with realization j, and f_1,...,f_r generators of I. Let L be any Roos triple for the strict quotient tower of M, in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-limit]. Then the explicit Koszul completion of M from [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] is isomorphic to L. There is such an isomorphism e for which, for every n, the composite of the intrinsic unit K -> completion(M), e, the product map of L, the n-th product projection, the exact restriction comparison and the inverse universal K-flat reduction comparison is exactly the unit of the normalized derived extension/restriction adjunction at K for A_T -> (A/I^(n+1))_T. No completeness assumption on K is required.

source.place: proof: Koszul reconstruction and bounded finite-projective quotient representative

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-koszul-augmentation-pro-zero] to the generators. Its maps are augmentations to A/I^(m+1), not merely to A/(f_i^(m+1)). Reindex to cochain complexes. Exact constant sheafification and flat extension to A_T, supplied by [lem-weil-pbc-completed-constant-sheaf-reduction], carry their zero derived cone transitions to zero maps. Derived tensor by the fixed K-flat representative M also preserves these zero maps and the cone squares.

The strict tensor augmentation is a morphism of strict tower complexes. The pro-zero-cone clause of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit] makes its total derived inverse limit invertible. Exact countable products identify the derived limit of the strict Koszul tensor tower with the explicit mapping cocone shifted by minus one in [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. Its map to the product is the Koszul-fibre projection.

Compare this quotient Roos triangle with the prescribed triple L by the triangulated morphism-of-triangles axiom, using identity maps on the two product vertices. The remaining map is invertible since those two maps are invertible. Its product square preserves each evaluation. The degree-zero formula for the algebraic augmentation sends the Koszul unit to the residue of 1. The normalized scalar adjunction and universal K-flat comparison of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] therefore identify the resulting evaluation with the derived adjunction unit. Conjugating by j transports this equality from M to K.

theorem completedKoszulRoosEvaluation {K : adicDatumDerived T d}
    (M : AdicDatumModel T d K) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = d.ideal)
    (L : CompletedSequentialDerivedLimit T d (adicDatumModelTower T d M)) :
    ∃ e : completedIntrinsicCompletion T d r f M.complex ≅ L.obj,
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        completedIntrinsicCompletionMap T d r f M.complex M.realization ≫
            e.hom ≫ L.p ≫
            Pi.π (fun a : ℕ ↦ (adicDatumModelTower T d M).obj (op a)) n ≫
            (adicDatumModelRestriction T d M n).hom ≫
            (adicDatumRestriction T (adicDatumProjection T d n)).map
              (adicDatumModelReductionIso T d M n).inv =
          (adicDatumAdjunction T (adicDatumProjection T d n)).unit.app K
